Bobby, saw EliseAI's $250M Series E and the push past $100M ARR into healthcare.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts than reps can work, and the bottleneck becomes the lag between a signal firing and someone acting on it. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach autonomously, so signal-to-action latency drops and coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Entering a new vertical like healthcare multiplies target accounts faster than ops can keep data clean or reps can follow up. The win is measurable lift per rep, not more seats and more manual work.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
